description: Minecraft Mod that brings MonHun weapons with their core mechanics and special additions.

mods.name: Sapphire Star Armaments
mods.description: The Hunter's Guild arrive alongside their mighty workshop! Become the Sapphire Star and expand your arsenal with an expanding weapon roster from the Monster Hunter franchise! Enjoy the core mechanics of each weapon accompanied by original Minecraft-inspired weapon designs.

releases.notes:
### Changelog 0.1.1

### New Features

- Guild Stock Box.
  - Spend points on consumables and different services
  - Buy original consumables.
  - Repair your weapons.
  - Buy experience levels.
  - Enjoy meals with long lasting effects.

- Mod Configs
  - Death Points Tax
  - XP to Points conversion rate
  - Cantine Cooldown Timer
  - Cantine Buff Duration

- 7 new consumables.

  - Potion
  - Mega Potion
  - Max Potion
  - Ancient Potion
  - Demon Powder
  - Hardshell Powder
  - Dust of Life


### Fixes and Changes

- Fixed Glaive Aerial Attack animation stuck when falling on water.
- Fixed multiplayer Glaive Aerial Attack animations desyncs
- Removed inertia on Kinsect launch.
- Fixed loss of full Item Box and Points on death.
- Fixed Kinsect getting stuck on water.

### Minor Additions

- Added description on Mauldrone Kinsect item.
- Added an aditional keybind for launching the Kinsect.
- Added translation keys for keybinds
- Reworked and added new commands (try /ssa)
- Reworked and added some player animations.

releases.notes:
### Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1

- Dependencies:
FabricAPI
GeckoLib 4
PlayerAnimator

### Initial Release Content:

- 6 Insect Glaives
Ore: Iron, Diamond, Netherite.
Mob: Phantom, Spider, Blaze.

- Kinsect
Equip on your off-hand while holding your Glaive to use Essences to boost yourself.

- 9 Mob Materials, 3 for each Mob
Phantom, Spider, Blaze.

- Item Box
Store your weapons and Mob Materials.
Sell your materials in exchange of points.

- Sapphire Forge
Forge all our weapons in the Sapphire Forge.
Spend your materials and points on forging.
Use both Item Box and Inventory materials while forging.
